findings.description: The 9 January 1875 record that FamilySearch hinted to Victoriana Vasquez (GFG9-7H4) is a VELACIÓN (nuptial blessing), NOT the couple's marriage. The index entries label it a marriage and name only the couple; reading the register image shows the entry is explicitly their velación of an already-married couple. The agent should recognize the 1875 event as a velación and should NOT report 9 January 1875 as the date Victoriana married Jose Cleofas Gutierrez.

details.place: San Ignacio de los Encinos, Parroquia de Ayo el Chico, Jalisco, Mexico (the FamilySearch index files this event under Degollado, Jalisco; the register image reads Ayo el Chico / San Ignacio de los Encinos)

supporting_sources: INDEXED event: the hint, 'Mexico, Marriages, 1570-1950' (ark:/61903/1:1:JC8N-Y3P), and its parish counterpart in 'Mexico, Jalisco, Catholic Church Records, 1590-2022' (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-DSBM, bride persona ark:/61903/1:1:684J-DSBS), both dated 9 Jan 1875, Degollado/Ayo el Chico; both index the event only as a marriage and name only the couple (no parents, ages, or residences).

CALIBRATED IMAGE READING (distinct from the index): the register page image ark:/61903/3:1:9392-VB9H-51 records this entry as a velación ('velados ... velé solamente ... este acto de su velacion'). This reading is licensed under the Step 1a two-entry check: two other indexed entries on the same image match the reading on couple, parents, and date -- Asencio x de Leon (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-LXF8, 12 Jan 1875) and Timoteo Rico x Virginia Garcia (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-8WXW / ark:/61903/1:1:XQFP-JG15, 8 Jan 1875).

findings.description: Victoriana Vasquez and Jose Cleofas Gutierrez actually married about 1859, not in 1875. The 1875 velación register states they had already been married sixteen years, at Huerta de San Juan, feligresía de San Pedro Piedragorda -- which places the marriage about 1859 at that place. The exact marriage date and the original marriage register are NOT established. The agent should conclude the couple's marriage predates the 1875 velación (about 1859, at Huerta de San Juan / San Pedro Piedragorda), rather than giving 9 January 1875 as the marriage.

details.date: about 1859 (approximate -- DERIVED from the velación register's 'married sixteen years' statement; the exact date is unknown and the original marriage register was not located)
details.place: Huerta de San Juan, feligresía de San Pedro Piedragorda (as named in the 1875 velación register; the original marriage register has not been located)

supporting_sources: CALIBRATED IMAGE READING: the 1875 velación register (ark:/61903/3:1:9392-VB9H-51) states the couple 'fueron casados han dieziseis años, en la Huerta de San Juan, feligresia de San Pedro Piedragorda' -- i.e. married about sixteen years earlier (~1859) at that place. This is a derived/secondary statement within the velación record; the original ~1859 marriage register (San Pedro Piedragorda) was searched for and NOT located, and the year is derived, not indexed.

IDENTITY (indexed): the 1879 Degollado civil death registration (ark:/61903/1:1:QGWN-N5CM) names Victoriana as the wife of Cleofas Gutierrez and the daughter of Remigio Vazquez and Maria Bernarda Sandoval -- tying the husband and parentage of tree person GFG9-7H4 to this couple.

MARRIAGE CORROBORATION (indexed children): daughter Maria Gregoria Gutierres Vazquez's 1879 death -- civil death registration ark:/61903/1:1:QGWJ-3HQ9 and parish burials ark:/61903/1:1:684X-KYNG and ark:/61903/1:1:684J-1Y17 (11 Jul 1879, Degollado); and daughter Silveria Gutierrez's 1900 marriages -- ark:/61903/1:1:QG71-GYY1, ark:/61903/1:1:QGQT-KZY4, and ark:/61903/1:1:XQZ8-RJT9 -- all naming Cleofas Gutierrez and Victoriana Vazquez as the parents. (No baptism record was located for either daughter.)
